evidence.what: many cars and trucks moving on main road through town
crowds of pedestrians along market stalls beside road
no police, ambulance, fire or tow vehicles visible

verdict.summary: No incident; busy but normal traffic through market town.
verdict.details: Aerial view of a busy town main road lined with market stalls and low buildings. Cars, vans, trucks and taxis move both directions with heavy roadside pedestrian activity. No crash, obstruction, or emergency responders visible. Traffic appears flowing normally.
